name: Andromeda III (Hubble)
blurb: Andromeda III, a dwarf spheroidal satellite of the Andromeda Galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: andromedaiii-hubble
story: Hubble resolved this faint companion of the Andromeda Galaxy into individual stars to read its history. Andromeda III formed most of its stars earlier than the other satellites in the study.

claims.text: Andromeda III is a dwarf spheroidal satellite of the Andromeda Galaxy
Hubble obtained deep color-magnitude diagrams of its stars to trace its star formation history
Andromeda III formed most of its stars much earlier than the other galaxies in the study
